I saved Pree's note to the workspace brain: the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Dock 23. The note records that it came from Pree in #central-team. I also replied in her thread there to say it's recorded.

Two things to know:
- **Duplicates:** The brain can only catch exact duplicates right now, so if this was already saved in different wording, there may now be two copies.
- **No account page:** There's no Marrow Agrisupply page in the brain yet. The note is saved as a standalone fact and wasn't added to a page.
